individualRoleChanges.denominator: Assignment appearances across evaluated rosters; not distinct players.

limitations: No actual outcomes exist for these novel layouts; measured improvements do not establish win-rate improvement.
Pareto protections are design constraints. Their non-regression alone does not establish empirical effectiveness.
Some individual players can take a less preferred role despite no increase in total or maximum team burden; disclose these counts and changes.
Zero known bottom violations is not a verified tier limit for an assignment with missing current tier.
